你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

## 平台
阿里巴巴国际站 · RFQ 回复

## 规则
[
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-01",
  "title_zh": "产品属性必须与实物一致",
  "excerpt": "Product attributes must be consistent with the actual condition of the product, and accurately showing the ingredients, materials, sizes, brands, models, places of origin",
  "question_zh": "回复或文案里的材质、尺寸、型号、产地等属性是否与已知产品资料一致（例如是否把塑料手柄/盖子的水壶说成全不锈钢）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-02",
  "title_zh": "付款与发货条件须符合真实能力",
  "excerpt": "Payment and shipping options must be consistent with the actual service capability of suppliers.",
  "question_zh": "回复中承诺的起订量、交期、港口、付款方式或单价，是否都有供应商提供的资料支撑，而不是模型自己编的？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-03",
  "title_zh": "发布的信息须真实、准确、合法",
  "excerpt": "Member should ensure that all information you post on the Sites is true, accurate and lawful and should not be false or misleading",
  "question_zh": "回复中是否有无法由产品资料证实、可能虚假或误导买家的说法（例如未提供证书却声称已获某认证）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-01",
  "title_zh": "FOB / FAS 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both apply only to sea or inland waterway transport (i.e. port-to-to port shipments).",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在空运、快递或陆运场景下使用了 FOB/FAS/CFR/CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-02",
  "title_zh": "集装箱货物更适合用 FCA",
  "excerpt": "FCA (Free Carrier) is the more appropriate Incoterms® rule.",
  "question_zh": "整柜或拼柜的集装箱报价用了 FOB 时，回复是否提示 FCA 可能更合适（可以作为可选项，不要求替换）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-03",
  "title_zh": "FOB：装上买方指定船只即完成交货，风险同时转移",
  "excerpt": "the seller delivers the goods loaded on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复对 FOB 的解释（谁订船、谁付运费、风险何时转移）是否与“装上买方指定船只即交货、风险转移”一致？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-04",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both Incoterms® CIF and Incoterms® CFR are used for sea or inland waterway transportation only.",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在非海运场景下报了 CFR 或 CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-05",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 风险在装运港装船时转移",
  "excerpt": "risk of loss of or damage to the goods transfers when the goods are placed on board the vessel at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复是否错误地表示 CFR/CIF 下卖方要承担运输途中直到目的港的风险？"
 }
]

## 待审文本（按字段）
{
 "reply": "Hi Mark,\n\nThank you for your inquiry about our 1.7L stainless steel kettle (model KET-17S). Before quoting, I need to be upfront about a few points so you can decide whether we are a good fit.\n\n1. UL listing\nThis model is not UL listed, and it does not have ETL either. Our current certifications are a CB report (IEC 60335-2-15) and CE (LVD/EMC). If UL or ETL is mandatory for your Amazon listing, please let me know. I will check with our team whether getting this model listed is feasible, and what the cost and timeline would be. I can't commit to it yet.\n\n2. BPA free\nThe inner body is 304 stainless steel. The lid and handle are PP plastic. We have not done a BPA test on this model, so we can't claim it is BPA free. We can check with our PP supplier for material documents. You are also welcome to have samples tested by a third-party lab of your choice.\n\n3. Price\n1,200 pcs: USD 9.80/pc, FOB Ningbo (sea freight, Ningbo-Zhoushan port).\nIf the goods are shipped in a container (FCL/LCL), FCA Ningbo may be a more suitable term. We can quote FCA as an alternative if you prefer.\nFOB is a sea-freight term, so this price is for shipment by sea. If you need air freight, we can discuss a different term, such as FCA, with your forwarder.\nYour logo on the color box is free of charge for this quantity. We just need your logo in vector format.\nMOQ is 500 pcs. Packing is a color box, 6 units per carton.\n\n4. Lead time\nOur production lead time is 35 days, so we are not able to deliver within 20 days. Shipping time is additional.\n\n5. Payment\nWe work with 30% T/T deposit and 70% against B/L copy, or L/C at sight. We are not able to accept 100% payment 60 days after delivery.\n\nProduct highlights: 120V 60Hz, 1500W, 304 stainless steel inner body, auto shut-off, boil-dry protection, 360° swivel base, and a concealed heating element that is easy to clean.\n\nNext steps:\n- Samples are available. They are charged at the unit price, and international freight is paid by you. The sample cost can be deducted from your bulk order.\n- We can also arrange a video factory tour through an Alibaba video call.\n\nPlease let me know whether the certification, lead time and payment terms above work for you. I'll be happy to move forward from there.\n\nBest regards,\nSales Team\nYongjiang Small Appliances"
}
